detail.body:
### What does this PR do?

This PR refactors Megatron QAT and low-precision rollout around a unified trainer-side weight quantization and rollout-side refit boundary.

- Add compressed-tensors-compatible trainer-side exporters for FP8_BLOCK, MXFP8, MXFP4, and NVFP4.
- Add ModelOpt-backed Megatron QAT modes: `fp8`, `mxfp8`, `mxfp4`, `mxfp4_mxfp8`, and `nvfp4`.
- Replace the string `rollout.quantization=fp8` API with structured `rollout.quantization.linear`, `moe`, `ignore`, and `config_file` settings.
- Load and refit pre-quantized weights in vLLM and SGLang instead of quantizing BF16 weights inside rollout workers.
- Add vLLM MXFP4/NVFP4 refit support, update FP8 refit handling, and update SGLang routing replay support.
- Add a unified QAT guide, migration notes, examples, CPU tests, and a rollout log-prob comparison tool.
- Remove the legacy `verl.utils.modelopt` implementation and TRT-LLM rollout quantization support.

Related to #5972 and #4066.

This PR has partial scope overlap with open low-precision work, but uses a materially different architecture: #7519 implements Transformer Engine shared-grid MXFP8 training and rollout, while this PR implements ModelOpt QAT plus a generalized trainer-side compressed-tensors export boundary for multiple formats; #7971 implements native Transformer Engine NVFP4 real quantization, while this PR implements NVFP4 fake-quant QAT and pre-quantized refit; #8205 fixes the legacy FSDP NVFP4 compressor API, while this PR refactors the Megatron and rollout path and does not add this feature to FSDP.

AI assistance was used to review the branch, fix two review findings, add a regression test, and prepare this PR description. The human submitter reviewed the changes and is responsible for the contribution end to end.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+QAT+compressed-tensors+rollout
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

Passed:

```bash
git diff --check origin/main...wuxibin/qat
python -m compileall -q verl/utils/qat verl/utils/vllm verl/workers/rollout/sglang_rollout verl/workers/rollout/trtllm_rollout
PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always
```

The full pre-commit suite passed, including Ruff, Ruff format, mypy, generated-config verification, repository sanity checks, and compileall.

The targeted pytest suites and GPU end-to-end tests were not run in this local environment because PyTorch, ModelOpt, and compressed-tensors were unavailable. CI/GPU validation should cover Megatron with vLLM and SGLang using FP8_BLOCK, plus MXFP8/MXFP4/NVFP4 on supported Blackwell hardware.

### API and Usage Example

The previous API:

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization=fp8
```

is replaced by:

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.linear=FP8_BLOCK \
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.moe=FP8_BLOCK
```

Enable matching Megatron QAT with:

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.qat.enable=true \
actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.qat.mode=fp8
```

Dense and routed-expert precision can be configured independently. For example, use BF16 dense layers and MXFP4 experts with:

```bash
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.linear=null \
actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.moe=MXFP4 \
actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.qat.enable=true \
actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.qat.mode=mxfp4
```

TRT-LLM no longer accepts `rollout.quantization`; use vLLM or SGLang for supported low-precision rollout configurations.

### Design & Code Changes

- Introduce `WeightQuantizer` dispatch based on rollout overrides or the model's native Hugging Face quantization config.
- Export canonical HF-named tensors from Megatron, quantize them on the trainer side, and transfer the final checkpoint layout through the checkpoint engine.
- Build compressed-tensors configs from per-layer presets and enforce QAT/rollout precision compatibility at startup.
- Add vLLM staging and post-load processing for FP8, MXFP8, MXFP4, and NVFP4 refits.
- Pass compressed-tensors model overrides to SGLang for FP8_BLOCK rollout.
- Keep default high-precision layers unquantized for both generated compressed-tensors configs and native FP8 configs.
- Consolidate low-precision documentation and provide `scripts/rollout_logprob_diff.py` for numerical comparison.
- Remove superseded ModelOpt/vLLM monkey-patch utilities and the TRT-LLM FP8 E2E job.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting).
- [x] Add / update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end tests to CI to cover all code. New CPU tests and updated FP8 E2E jobs are included, but ModelOpt/compressed-tensors test dependency coverage and MXFP4/NVFP4 E2E coverage still need confirmation.
- [ ] Once this PR is ready for CI, send a message in the [`ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1).
- [x] Recipe submodule update is not applicable; this PR does not change the recipe submodule.

 ### Implementation
 
-We monkey patch several vLLM functions to enable FP8 rollout for reinforcement learning:
-
-1. **Quantize weights**: Quantize model weights on-the-fly from higher-precision formats to FP8.
-2. **Process weights after loading**: For vLLM, we replace the `vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8.Fp8LinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading` function to handle weight processing after quantization. For SGLang, this patch is not needed as it natively supports loading quantized weights.
+The rollout engine starts from a compressed-tensors `quantization_config` with dummy weights, and the trainer quantizes every weight sync to that config with the compressed-tensors compressors (`verl/utils/qat/compressed_tensors.py`). On the vLLM side we monkey patch `process_weights_after_loading` of the compressed-tensors FP8 linear/MoE methods so refits are written back into the live parameters (`verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp8_utils.py`).
 
 ### Support Matrix
 
-- FP8 blockwise quantization for rollout
+- FP8 blockwise quantization for rollout (compressed-tensors preset `FP8_BLOCK`)
   - Used in Deepseek, which is 1x128 quantization for activations and 128x128 quantization for model weights
 - Dense models and MoE models
 - Async rollout interfaces
-- vLLM 0.10.x & vLLM 0.11 & vLLM 0.12 & SGLang 0.5.5
-- FSDP and Megatron training backends
+- vLLM or SGLang rollout (SGLang validated on Hopper only) with the Megatron training backend; TRT-LLM and FSDP are not supported
 
 ### Usage
 
 Enable in config file:
 
 ```yaml
 rollout:
-  quantization: "fp8"
+  quantization:
+    linear: FP8_BLOCK  # dense linear layers (attention, dense MLP, shared experts)
+    moe: FP8_BLOCK     # routed experts
+    ignore: []         # extra "re:" patterns kept in BF16
 ```
 
 Or via command line:
 
 ```bash
-actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization=fp8
-```
-
-#### Skipping layers in SGLang FP8 rollout
-
-When using SGLang FP8 rollout, you can skip FP8 weight quantization for
-selected modules. Skipped modules stay in the rollout model dtype instead
-of being converted to FP8. This is useful for layers that are not
-compatible with block-wise FP8 weight quantization, or for modules that
-you prefer to keep in higher precision.
-
-Set `SGLANG_FP8_IGNORED_LAYERS` before starting training:
-
-```bash
-SGLANG_FP8_IGNORED_LAYERS=linear_attn \
-python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
-  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=sglang \
-  actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization=fp8 \
-  ...
-```
-
-Multiple entries can be separated by commas:
-
-```bash
-SGLANG_FP8_IGNORED_LAYERS=linear_attn,visual
-```
-
-You can also use the model `quantization_config`:
-
-```json
-{
-  "quantization_config": {
-    "ignored_layers": ["re:.*linear_attn.*"]
-  }
-}
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.linear=FP8_BLOCK \
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.moe=FP8_BLOCK
 ```
 
-Plain module names, full module paths, and `re:` regex patterns are
-supported. verl applies the same ignored-layer rules when launching
-SGLang and when syncing updated actor weights into the rollout engine.
+Routers, `lm_head`, embeddings, vision towers and MTP layers stay in BF16 by default, as do layers whose weight shape is not a multiple of the 128x128 block. To provide a complete compressed-tensors `quantization_config` instead, set `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.quantization.config_file=/path/to/quantization_config.json` (exclusive with `linear` / `moe` / `ignore`).
 
 ### Experiments and Outcomes

-# NVFP4 QAT (Quantization-Aware Training) in verl
+# NVFP4 QAT
 
-Last updated: 04/02/2026
+Last updated: 10/19/2026
+verl supports NVFP4 as **W4A4 routed experts** on Blackwell:
 
-verl supports NVFP4 Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), which applies fake quantization during training so the model learns to tolerate NVFP4 quantization error. At rollout time, weights are packed into real NVFP4 format for vLLM inference. This closes the precision gap between training and inference, preventing KL divergence explosion.
+- trainer: Megatron + ModelOpt QAT
+- rollout: vLLM compressed-tensors
+- kernel: FlashInfer CUTLASS
+- dense linear layers: BF16 or MXFP8; NVFP4 linear is not supported
 
-| Training Backend | Training Precision | Rollout Precision | vLLM Quant Method |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| **FSDP** | BF16 + fake quantization | NVFP4 W4A16 | `compressed-tensors` |
-| **Megatron** | BF16 + fake quantization | NVFP4 W4A16 | `modelopt` |
+W4A16, FSDP NVFP4 and non-CUTLASS NVFP4 backends are not supported by this
+path.
 
-> [!TIP]
-> For ready-to-run scripts, environment setup, and experimental results, see the [QAT recipe](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-recipe/tree/main/qat).
-
----
-
-## Key Configuration
-
-### FSDP Backend
-
-Configured under `actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.qat`:
-
-```yaml
-actor_rollout_ref:
-  actor:
-    fsdp_config:
-      qat:
-        enable: true
-        mode: "w4a16"
-        group_size: 16
-        ignore_patterns:
-          - "lm_head"
-          - "embed_tokens"
-          - "re:.*mlp.gate$"
-        quantization_config_path: "recipe/qat/config/nvfp4_w4a16.json"
-```
-
-| Parameter | Description | Default |
-|-----------|-------------|---------|
-| `fsdp_config.qat.enable` | Enable QAT | `False` |
-| `fsdp_config.qat.mode` | Quantization mode | `"w4a16"` |
-| `fsdp_config.qat.group_size` | Quantization group size | `16` |
-| `fsdp_config.qat.ignore_patterns` | Layers to skip. Supports `re:` prefix for regex, otherwise substring match | `["lm_head", "embed_tokens", "re:.*mlp.gate$"]` |
-| `fsdp_config.qat.quantization_config_path` | vLLM quantization config JSON path | Required |
-
-### Megatron Backend
-
-Configured under `actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.qat`:
+## Configuration
 
 ```yaml
 actor_rollout_ref:
   actor:
     megatron:
       qat:
         enable: true
-        mode: "w4a16"
-        group_size: 16

Running rollout in low precision: + +- shrinks weight memory, leaving more room for KV cache and higher concurrency; +- reduces memory traffic during decode, improving throughput; +- uses FP8/FP4 Tensor Cores on Hopper/Blackwell to speed up prefill. + +The cost is a numerical gap between the high-precision trainer and the low-precision rollout (training-inference mismatch). It makes importance sampling and off-policy correction less accurate and, in bad cases, destabilizes training. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) narrows this gap by training the model against the same quantization the rollout uses. + +## Background: model weight formats + +HuggingFace checkpoints come in two flavors: + +1. **High precision**: BF16 weights, no `quantization_config` in `config.json`. +2. **Low precision**: `config.json` carries a `quantization_config` describing how each layer is quantized. Models often use different formats for linear layers (attention, dense MLP, shared experts) and MoE (routed experts). + +| Model | Architecture | `quant_method` | Linear | MoE (routed experts) | Not quantized | +|---|---|---|---|---|---| +| [Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B/blob/main/config.json) | 92 layers, 512 experts, top-10 | none | BF16 | BF16 | - | +| [zai-org/GLM-5.2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.2/blob/main/config.json) | 78 layers, 256 experts, top-8, first 3 dense | none | BF16 | BF16 | - | +| [zai-org/GLM-5.3](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3/blob/main/config.json) | same as GLM-5.2 | `fp8` | FP8 E4M3, 128x128 block, FP32 scale (`weight_scale_inv`), dynamic activation | same as linear | router `mlp.gate`, `indexers_proj`, `embed_tokens`, `lm_head`, MTP `eh_proj`, norms (`modules_to_not_convert`) | +| [moonshotai/Kimi-K3](https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/blob/main/config.json) | 93 layers, 896 experts, first layer dense | `compressed-tensors` | BF16 | MXFP4 W4A16: FP4 E2M1, 1x32 group, UE8M0 scale (`weight_packed` + `weight_scale`) | `self_attn`, `shared_experts`, dense `mlp`, `lm_head`, `vision_tower`, `mm_projector` (`ignore` regex) | +| [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash/blob/main/config.json) | 40 layers, 384 experts, top-6 | `fp8` | FP8 E4M3, 32x32 block (`wo_a` may be 128x128), UE8M0 scale (`scale_fmt: ue8m0`) | FP4 E2M1, 1x32 group, UE8M0 scale (`expert_dtype: fp4`), same layout as MXFP4 | router `ffn.gate`, indexer `wk`/`weights_proj`, `compressor` | + +- GLM-5.3 uses the standard HF FineGrainedFP8 format (same as DeepSeek-V3), which both vLLM and SGLang parse. +- Kimi-K3 uses compressed-tensors: a `Linear`-targeted config group plus an `ignore` list that excludes non-expert layers yields "linear BF16 + MoE MXFP4". +- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's `fp8` config has private fields (`scale_fmt`, `expert_dtype`) and needs dedicated engine support. + +The trainer always trains in high precision; low-precision checkpoints are dequantized before training. The rollout uses the model's own `quantization_config` if it has one; a BF16 model can run rollout in BF16 or, for higher throughput, in low precision through `rollout.quantization`. + +## How it works + +- **Trainer**: always trains in high precision (BF16). With QAT enabled, the forward pass uses fake-quantized weights (quantize then dequantize) and gradients flow through a straight-through estimator. +- **Rollout**: the inference engine starts with dummy weights and either the model's native + `quantization_config` or a `rollout.quantization` override. It allocates parameters as if + it were loading that low-precision checkpoint (for example FP8 `weight` + + `weight_scale_inv`). +- **Weight refit export**: the training backend first exports weights under canonical + HuggingFace names. A trainer-side `WeightQuantizer`, selected from the effective rollout + `quantization_config`, converts each sync bucket into exactly the checkpoint tensors + expected by the rollout engine. Standard native FP8 is quantized to the `Fp8Config` + layout; native and overridden compressed-tensors configs use the same + compressed-tensors exporter. DeepSeek-V4 is already quantized by Megatron-Bridge, so its + exporter only normalizes the packed byte dtype. The rollout worker therefore loads + pre-quantized tensors and is not responsible for quantization. + +![weight_quant](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-data/blob/main/images/weight_quantizer_refit.png?raw=true) + +This exporter/loader boundary is intended to decouple the two sides. The target architecture +is the Cartesian product of training backends `[Megatron, VeOmni, TorchTitan]` and rollout +engines `[vLLM, SGLang]`: each trainer exports canonical named tensors, each +`WeightQuantizer` defines a checkpoint wire format, and each rollout engine only implements +loading/refit for that format. The support matrix below records the combinations currently +validated; it does not imply that the full target matrix is implemented yet. + +For an override-based rollout, the HuggingFace checkpoint stays in BF16; no offline +quantization or calibration step is needed. This is intentionally different from compressed-tensors' `MXFP4` preset, which is W4A4, and from vLLM's native `Mxfp4Config`, whose checkpoint format is nominally W4A16. + +## Configuration + +### Rollout quantization + +```yaml +actor_rollout_ref: + rollout: + quantization: + linear: FP8_BLOCK # attention, dense MLP, shared experts + moe: FP8_BLOCK # routed experts + ignore: [] # extra layers kept in BF16: exact names or "re:" + config_file: null # path to a compressed-tensors quantization_config JSON +``` + +- When `linear`, `moe` and `config_file` are all `null` (the default), the rollout runs in the model's native precision. +- `linear` and `moe` can be set independently. Setting one of them to `null` keeps those layers in BF16, e.g. `linear: null, moe: FP8_BLOCK` quantizes only the routed experts. +- `MXFP4` and `NVFP4` are valid only for `moe`. +def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
+    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default="~/models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B")

+def build_config(args: argparse.Namespace) -> DictConfig:
+    config_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(verl.__file__), "trainer", "config")
+    with initialize_config_dir(config_dir=config_dir, version_base=None):
+        config = compose(
+            config_name="ppo_trainer",

+def init_workers(config: DictConfig) -> tuple[AgentLoopManager, RayWorkerGroup, CheckpointEngineManager]:
+    """Hybrid actor/rollout workers + agent loop, without reward model."""
+    pool_id = "global_pool"
+    resource_pool_manager = ResourcePoolManager(
+        resource_pool_spec={pool_id: [config.trainer.n_gpus_per_node] * config.trainer.nnodes},
+        mapping={Role.ActorRollout: pool_id},
+    )
+    resource_pool_manager.create_resource_pool()
+    resource_pool = resource_pool_manager.get_resource_pool(Role.ActorRollout)
+
+    class_dict = {
+        "actor_rollout": RayClassWithInitArgs(
+            cls=ray.remote(ActorRolloutRefWorker), config=config.actor_rollout_ref, role="actor_rollout"
+        )
+    }
+    wg_dict = RayWorkerGroup(
+        resource_pool=resource_pool,
+        ray_cls_with_init=create_colocated_worker_cls(class_dict=class_dict),
+        device_name=get_device_name(),
+    )
+    actor_rollout_wg = wg_dict.spawn(prefix_set=class_dict.keys())["actor_rollout"]
+    actor_rollout_wg.init_model()
+
+    reward_loop_manager = RewardLoopManager(config=config, rm_resource_pool=None)
+    llm_server_manager = LLMServerManager.create(config=config, worker_group=actor_rollout_wg)
+    agent_loop_manager = AgentLoopManager.create(
+        config=config,
+        llm_client=llm_server_manager.get_client(),
+        reward_loop_worker_handles=reward_loop_manager.reward_loop_workers,
+    )
+    checkpoint_manager = CheckpointEngineManager(
+        config=omega_conf_to_dataclass(config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.checkpoint_engine),
+        actor_wg=actor_rollout_wg,
+        replicas=llm_server_manager.get_replicas(),
+    )
+    checkpoint_manager.sleep_replicas()
+    checkpoint_manager.update_weights()
+    return agent_loop_manager, actor_rollout_wg, checkpoint_manager

+def compute_old_log_prob(actor_rollout_wg: RayWorkerGroup, batch: DataProto) -> DataProto:
+    """Same as RayPPOTrainer._compute_old_log_prob."""
+    batch_td = left_right_2_no_padding(batch.to_tensordict())
+    tu.assign_non_tensor(batch_td, calculate_entropy=True, compute_loss=False)
+    output = actor_rollout_wg.compute_log_prob(batch_td)
+    log_probs = no_padding_2_padding(tu.get(output, "log_probs"), batch_td)
+    return DataProto.from_tensordict(tu.get_tensordict({"old_log_probs": log_probs.float()}))
+

+def main() -> int:
+    args = parse_args()
+    if args.refit_rounds < 1:
+        raise ValueError("--refit-rounds must be at least 1")
+    config = build_config(args)
+
+    ray.init(
+        runtime_env={
+            "env_vars": {
+                "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": "true",
+                "NCCL_DEBUG": "WARN",
+                "VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL": "INFO",
+                "VLLM_USE_V1": "1",
+                "VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM": "0",
+                "CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS": "1",
+            }
+        }
+    )
+    agent_loop_manager, actor_rollout_wg, checkpoint_manager = init_workers(config)
+
+    raw_prompts = [[{"role": "user", "content": q}] for q in QUESTIONS]
+    batch = DataProto(
+        non_tensor_batch={
+            "raw_prompt": np.array(raw_prompts),
+            "agent_name": np.array(["single_turn_agent"] * len(raw_prompts)),
+            "data_source": np.array(["openai/gsm8k"] * len(raw_prompts)),
+            "reward_model": np.array([{"style": "rule", "ground_truth": "1.0"}] * len(raw_prompts)),
+        },
+    ).repeat(config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n)
+
+    refit_runs = []
+    for round_index in range(args.refit_rounds):
+        if round_index:
+            checkpoint_manager.update_weights()
+        result = agent_loop_manager.generate_sequences(prompts=batch)
+        checkpoint_manager.sleep_replicas()
+        result.meta_info.pop("timing", None)
+
+        result.meta_info["temperature"] = config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature
+        result.meta_info["global_token_num"] = torch.sum(result.batch["attention_mask"], dim=-1).tolist()
+        result = result.union(compute_old_log_prob(actor_rollout_wg, result))
+
+        old_log_probs = result.batch["old_log_probs"]
+        rollout_log_probs = result.batch["rollout_log_probs"]
+        response_mask = result.batch["response_mask"].bool()
+
+        metrics = compute_offpolicy_metrics(
+            old_log_prob=old_log_probs, rollout_log_prob=rollout_log_probs, response_mask=response_mask
+        )
+        metrics.update(calculate_debug_metrics(result))
+        log_prob_abs_diff = (old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs).abs()[response_mask]
+        metrics["log_prob_abs_diff_mean"] = log_prob_abs_diff.mean().item()
+        metrics["log_prob_abs_diff_max"] = log_prob_abs_diff.max().item()
+        metrics["num_response_tokens"] = int(response_mask.sum().item())
+        refit_runs.append(metrics)
+
+    metrics = dict(refit_runs[-1])
+    if len(refit_runs) > 1:
+        metrics["refit_runs"] = refit_runs
+    print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2))
+    ray.shutdown()
+
+    k3_kl = metrics["k3_kl"]
+    if not (np.isfinite(metrics["kl"]) and np.isfinite(k3_kl)) or k3_kl >= args.max_k3_kl:
+        print(f"FAILED: k3_kl {k3_kl} (threshold {args.max_k3_kl})")
+        return 1
+    print("PASSED")
+    return 0
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+def _load_fp4_utils():
+    path = _REPO_ROOT / "verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp4_utils.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vllm_fp4_utils_under_test", path)
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module

+_FP4_UTILS = _load_fp4_utils()

+_restore_nvfp4_kernel_config_in_place = _FP4_UTILS._restore_nvfp4_kernel_config_in_place
+_stage_mxfp4_moe_params = _FP4_UTILS._stage_mxfp4_moe_params

+    module.quant_method = _PackedMxfp4Method()
+    module.weight_loader = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
+    module.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 1, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 1, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)

+    live_w13 = module.w13_weight
+    live_w2 = module.w2_weight

+    assert module.w13_weight_packed.weight_loader == module.weight_loader

+The rollout config either selects a compressed-tensors preset scheme per layer kind::
+
+    quantization:

+      moe: FP8_BLOCK     # routed experts

+

+``build_compressed_tensors_config``) turns that into the HF ``quantization_config``
+the inference engine is started with (``load_format=dummy``), and
+``CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer`` quantizes the trainer's exported HF weights

+    "MXFP8": "mxfp8",
+    # There is no compressed-tensors preset for this combination.  verl's
+    # MXFP4 mode deliberately means MXFP4 expert weights with dynamically
+    # quantized MXFP8 expert inputs, rather than the upstream MXFP4 W4A4
+    # preset.
+    "MXFP4": "mxfp4",
+    # NVFP4 is deliberately W4A4 and routed-expert-only.  Unlike MX formats,
+    # its tensor-level activation scale is static and must come from QAT.
+    "NVFP4": "nvfp4",
+}
+
+# Layers that stay in high precision regardless of model. Patterns must start
+# with "re:": vLLM rewrites plain dotted names through the model's
+# WeightsMapper, but leaves regexes alone, so these match on both sides.
+DEFAULT_IGNORE = [
+    r"re:.*lm_head$",
+    r"re:.*embed_tokens$",
+    r"re:.*visual\..*",
+    r"re:^mtp\..*",
+    r"re:.*mlp\.gate$",
+    r"re:.*shared_expert_gate$",
+]
+
+
+_HIGH_PRECISION_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32)
+
+
+def _check_scheme(kind: str, scheme: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if scheme is None:
+        return None
+    scheme = scheme.upper()
+    if scheme not in SUPPORTED_SCHEMES:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported rollout quantization {kind}={scheme!r}, choose from {sorted(SUPPORTED_SCHEMES)}")
+    return scheme
+
+
+_NUMERIC_FIELDS = {
+    "num_bits",
+    "type",
+    "symmetric",
+    "group_size",
+    "strategy",
+    "block_structure",
+    "dynamic",
+    "scale_dtype",
+}
+
+
+def _numerics(args: Optional["QuantizationArgs"]) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return None if args is None else args.model_dump(include=_NUMERIC_FIELDS)
+
+
+def _preset_of(scheme: "QuantizationScheme") -> Optional[str]:
+    """The supported preset ``scheme`` quantizes like, ignoring observers and targets."""
+
+    for preset in SUPPORTED_SCHEMES:
+        reference = _scheme_for_preset(preset, scheme.targets)
+        if all(
+            _numerics(getattr(scheme, kind)) == _numerics(getattr(reference, kind))
+            for kind in ("weights", "input_activations", "output_activations")
+        ):
+            return preset
+    return None
+
+
+def _group_schemes(ct_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list["QuantizationScheme"]:
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationScheme
+
+    return [
+        QuantizationScheme.model_validate({k: v for k, v in group.items() if k != "format"})
+        for group in ct_config["config_groups"].values()
+    ]
+
+
+def qat_modes_for_config(ct_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> set[Optional[str]]:
+    """ModelOpt QAT modes whose fake quant matches the config groups of a rollout ``quantization_config``."""
+    presets = {_preset_of(scheme) for scheme in _group_schemes(ct_config)}
+    if presets == {"MXFP4", "MXFP8"}:
+        return {"mxfp4_mxfp8"}
+    return {SUPPORTED_SCHEMES[preset] for preset in presets}
+
+
+def _matches(name: str, targets: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
+    for target in targets:
+        if target.startswith("re:"):
+            if re.match(target[3:], name):
+                return True
+        elif name == target:
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _scheme_for_preset(preset: str, targets: list[str]) -> "QuantizationScheme":
+    """Resolve verl presets, including the MXFP4-weight/MXFP8-input combination."""
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization import preset_name_to_scheme
+
+    scheme = preset_name_to_scheme(preset, targets)
+    if preset == "MXFP4":
+        mxfp8 = preset_name_to_scheme("MXFP8", targets)
+        scheme = scheme.model_copy(update={"input_activations": mxfp8.input_activations})
+    return scheme
+
+
+def _config_group(targets: list[str], preset: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    from compressed_tensors.compressors.format import infer_module_format
+
+    scheme = _scheme_for_preset(preset, targets)
+    group = scheme.model_dump(mode="json", exclude_none=True)
+    group["format"] = infer_module_format(torch.nn.Linear, scheme).value
+    return group
+
+
+def _load_config_file(config_file: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Read a compressed-tensors ``quantization_config`` (bare, or inside an HF ``config.json``)."""
+    with open(config_file) as f:
+        config = json.load(f)
+    config = config.get("quantization_config", config)
+    if config.get("quant_method") != "compressed-tensors" or not config.get("config_groups"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{config_file} is not a compressed-tensors quantization_config with config_groups")
+    for name, scheme in zip(config["config_groups"], _group_schemes(config), strict=True):
+        if _preset_of(scheme) is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{config_file}: config group {name!r} does not match any supported scheme {sorted(SUPPORTED_SCHEMES)}"
+            )
+    return config
+
+
+def build_compressed_tensors_config(
+    *,
+    linear: Optional[str],
+    moe: Optional[str],
+    ignore: Iterable[str],
+    config_file: Optional[str],
+    model_path: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build the HF compressed-tensors ``quantization_config`` for the rollout engine.
+
+    Prefer ``RolloutQuantizationConfig.build_quantization_config``; the arguments mirror its fields.
+    """
+    ignore = list(ignore or [])
+    if config_file:
+        if linear or moe or ignore:
+            raise ValueError("rollout.quantization.config_file is exclusive with linear / moe / ignore")
+        return _load_config_file(config_file)
+
+    linear = _check_scheme("linear", linear)
+    moe = _check_scheme("moe", moe)
+    if linear in ("MXFP4", "NVFP4"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{linear} is supported only for routed MoE experts; use BF16 or MXFP8 dense linear layers")
+    if linear is None and moe is None:
+        raise ValueError("rollout quantization needs at least one of `linear` / `moe`")
+
+    ignore = DEFAULT_IGNORE + ignore
+
+    config_groups: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if linear == moe:
+        config_groups["group_0"] = _config_group(["Linear"], linear)
+    else:
+        # A regex target wins over the class name, so experts always get the MoE scheme.
+        if moe is not None:
+            config_groups["group_moe"] = _config_group([MOE_TARGET], moe)
+        else:
+            ignore.append(MOE_TARGET)
+        if linear is not None:
+            config_groups["group_linear"] = _config_group(["Linear"], linear)
+
+    formats = {g["format"] for g in config_groups.values()}
+    return {
+        "quant_method": "compressed-tensors",
+        "format": formats.pop() if len(formats) == 1 else "mixed-precision",
+        "quantization_status": "compressed",
+        "config_groups": config_groups,
+        "ignore": ignore,
+        "kv_cache_scheme": None,
+        "sparsity_config": {},
+        "global_compression_ratio": None,
+    }
+
+
+def _weight_min_max(weight: torch.Tensor, args: "QuantizationArgs") -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Per-tile min/max of a 2D weight, shaped like the scale the strategy expects."""
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization.utils import maybe_pad_tensor_for_block_quant
+
+    if args.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.BLOCK:
+        rows, cols = args.block_structure
+        padded = maybe_pad_tensor_for_block_quant(weight, (rows, cols))
+        tiles = padded.unflatten(1, (-1, cols)).unflatten(0, (-1, rows))
+        return tiles.amin(dim=(1, 3)), tiles.amax(dim=(1, 3))
+    if args.strategy in (QuantizationStrategy.GROUP, QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP):
+        groups = weight.unflatten(-1, (-1, args.group_size))
+        return groups.amin(dim=-1), groups.amax(dim=-1)
+    if args.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.CHANNEL:
+        return weight.amin(dim=-1, keepdim=True), weight.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+    if args.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR:
+        return weight.amin(), weight.amax()
+    raise NotImplementedError(f"Trainer-side quantization not implemented for strategy {args.strategy}")
+
+
+def _compress_weight(
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    scheme: "QuantizationScheme",
+    *,
+    global_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Quantize one module's weight into its compressed-tensors state dict."""
+    from compressed_tensors.compressors import BaseCompressor
+    from compressed_tensors.compressors.format import infer_module_format
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+    from compressed_tensors.quantization.utils import calculate_qparams, generate_gparam
+
+    args = scheme.weights
+    min_vals, max_vals = (t.float() for t in _weight_min_max(weight, args))
+    state_dict = {"weight": weight}
+    if args.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP:
+        if global_scale is None:
+            global_scale = generate_gparam(min_vals.amin(), max_vals.amax())
+        state_dict["weight_global_scale"] = global_scale
+    scale, zero_point = calculate_qparams(min_vals, max_vals, args, global_scale=global_scale)
+    state_dict["weight_scale"] = scale
+    if not args.symmetric:
+        state_dict["weight_zero_point"] = zero_point
+    compressor = BaseCompressor.get_value_from_registry(infer_module_format(torch.nn.Linear, scheme).value)
+    return compressor.compress(state_dict, scheme)
+
+
+# HF checkpoints that pack all routed experts into one 3D tensor (e.g. Qwen3.5 MoE).
+_PACKED_EXPERTS = re.compile(r"(?P<prefix>.*\.experts)\.(?P<proj>gate_up_proj|down_proj)(?:\.weight)?$")
+
+
+def _unpack_experts(name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """``experts.gate_up_proj`` [E, 2I, H] / ``experts.down_proj`` [E, H, I] -> per-expert 2D ``*.weight``.
+
+    The engines load per-expert names with their scales, while their packed
+    3D loaders only map the weight itself.
+    """
+    match = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name)
+    prefix, proj = match["prefix"], match["proj"]
+    for expert_id, weight in enumerate(tensor):
+        if proj == "gate_up_proj":
+            gate, up = weight.chunk(2, dim=0)
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.gate_proj.weight", gate
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.up_proj.weight", up
+        else:
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.down_proj.weight", weight
+
+
+class CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer:
+    """Quantize exported HF weights to match a compressed-tensors rollout config.
+
+    A weight is quantized iff it is a 2D ``*.weight`` whose module is not
+    ignored and is targeted by a config group, resolved like compressed-tensors
+    does: a name / "re:" target wins over the ``Linear`` class target. Packed 3D
+    experts are split per expert first. Everything else passes through unchanged.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        ct_config: Mapping[str, Any],
+        input_global_scales: Optional[Mapping[str, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+    ):
+        self.ignore = list(ct_config.get("ignore") or [])
+        self.schemes = _group_schemes(ct_config)
+        self.linear_scheme = next((s for s in self.schemes if "Linear" in s.targets), None)
+        self.input_global_scales = dict(input_global_scales or {})
+
+    def set_input_global_scales(self, scales: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+        """Install ModelOpt-observed NVFP4 activation scales keyed by HF module name."""
+        self.input_global_scales = dict(scales)
+
+    def refresh_input_global_scales(self, model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        """Refresh NVFP4 activation scales from ModelOpt before an export."""
+        from verl.utils.qat.modelopt import collect_nvfp4_input_global_scales
+
+        scales = collect_nvfp4_input_global_scales(model)
+        if scales:
+            self.set_input_global_scales(scales)
+
+    def _input_global_scale(self, module: str, scheme: "QuantizationScheme") -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+
+        if scheme.input_activations is None or scheme.input_activations.strategy != QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP:
+            return None
+        scale = self.input_global_scales.get(module)
+        if scale is None:
+            match = re.search(r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.mlp\.experts\.\d+\.(gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj)$", module)
+            if match:
+                projection = "gate_up" if match.group(2) in ("gate_proj", "up_proj") else "down"
+                scale = self.input_global_scales.get(f"layers.{match.group(1)}.mlp.experts.{projection}")
+        if scale is None:
+            # The first rollout sync precedes any actor forward, so no observer
+            # value exists yet.  One is the neutral CT divisor and leaves the
+            # dynamic group-16 FP8 local scales their full representable range.
+            scale = torch.ones(1)
+        scale = scale.detach().float().reshape(1)
+        if not torch.isfinite(scale).all() or (scale <= 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid input_global_scale for {module!r}: {scale}")
+        return scale
+
+    def _compress_packed_experts(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        scheme: "QuantizationScheme",
+    ) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        """Compress packed experts, sharing NVFP4 gate/up tensor scales."""
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization.utils import generate_gparam
+
+        unpacked = list(_unpack_experts(name, tensor))
+        shared_global_scales: dict[tuple[int, str], torch.Tensor] = {}
+        if scheme.weights.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP:
+            by_expert: dict[int, list[torch.Tensor]] = {}
+            for module_name, weight in unpacked:
+                match = re.search(r"\.experts\.(\d+)\.(gate_proj|up_proj)\.weight$", module_name)
+                if match:
+                    by_expert.setdefault(int(match.group(1)), []).append(weight)
+            for expert_id, weights in by_expert.items():
+                amax = torch.stack([weight.float().abs().amax() for weight in weights]).amax()
+                shared_global_scales[(expert_id, "gate_up")] = generate_gparam(-amax, amax)
+
+        for weight_name, weight in unpacked:
+            module = weight_name[: -len(".weight")]
+            match = re.search(r"\.experts\.(\d+)\.(gate_proj|up_proj)$", module)
+            global_scale = shared_global_scales.get((int(match.group(1)), "gate_up")) if match else None
+            compressed = _compress_weight(weight, scheme, global_scale=global_scale)
+            for key, value in compressed.items():
+                yield weight_name[: -len("weight")] + key, value
+            input_scale = self._input_global_scale(module, scheme)
+            if input_scale is not None:
+                yield weight_name[: -len("weight")] + "input_global_scale", input_scale
+
+    def _module_scheme(self, module: str) -> Optional["QuantizationScheme"]:
+        if _matches(module, self.ignore):
+            return None
+        for scheme in self.schemes:
+            if _matches(module, scheme.targets):
+                return scheme
+        return self.linear_scheme
+
+    def _scheme_for(self, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Optional["QuantizationScheme"]:
+        if not name.endswith(".weight") or tensor.ndim != 2 or tensor.dtype not in _HIGH_PRECISION_DTYPES:
+            return None
+        return self._module_scheme(name[: -len(".weight")])
+
+    def __call__(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            packed = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name) if tensor.ndim == 3 else None
+            scheme = self._module_scheme(f"{packed['prefix']}.0.gate_proj") if packed else None
+            if packed and scheme is not None:
+                yield from self._compress_packed_experts(name, tensor, scheme)
+                continue
+            scheme = self._scheme_for(name, tensor)
+            if scheme is None:
+                yield name, tensor
+                continue
+            prefix = name[: -len("weight")]
+            for key, value in _compress_weight(tensor, scheme).items():
+                yield prefix + key, value
+            input_scale = self._input_global_scale(name[: -len(".weight")], scheme)
+            if input_scale is not None:
+                yield prefix + "input_global_scale", input_scale
+
+
+class Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer:
+    """Export trainer weights in vLLM's native blockwise ``Fp8Config`` layout.
+
+    Unlike :class:`CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer`, this keeps the rollout's
+    native ``Fp8Config`` and therefore emits ``weight_scale_inv`` rather than
+    compressed-tensors' ``weight_scale``.  The quantization calculation is
+    shared with the compressed-tensors FP8_BLOCK exporter.
+
+    DeepSeek-V4 uses this dispatcher entry too, but the quantizer passes through
+    its private mixed FP8/FP4 layout already exported by Megatron-Bridge.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, fp8_config: Mapping[str, Any], *, model_types: Iterable[Optional[str]] = ()):
+        quant_method = str(fp8_config.get("quant_method", "")).lower()
+        self.passthrough = bool({"deepseek_v4", "deepseek_v41"} & set(model_types))
+        if self.passthrough:
+            return
+        activation_scheme = fp8_config.get("activation_scheme")
+        block_size = fp8_config.get("weight_block_size")
+        store_dtype = fp8_config.get("store_dtype")
+        if "fp8" not in quant_method:
+            raise ValueError(f"Expected an FP8 quantization config, got quant_method={quant_method!r}")
+        if activation_scheme != "dynamic" or block_size != [128, 128] or store_dtype is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Trainer-side native Fp8Config export currently supports only standard "
+                "FP8_BLOCK (dynamic activations, 128x128 weights, no mixed expert store_dtype); "
+                f"got activation_scheme={activation_scheme!r}, weight_block_size={block_size!r}, "
+                f"store_dtype={store_dtype!r}"
+            )
+        self.ignore = list(fp8_config.get("ignored_layers") or fp8_config.get("modules_to_not_convert") or [])
+        self.ignore_match_mode = fp8_config.get("ignored_layers_match_mode", "exact")
+        if self.ignore_match_mode not in ("exact", "substring", "suffix"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ignored_layers_match_mode={self.ignore_match_mode!r}")
+        self.scheme = _scheme_for_preset("FP8_BLOCK", ["Linear"])
+
+    def _is_ignored(self, module: str) -> bool:
+        if _matches(module, DEFAULT_IGNORE):
+            return True
+        if self.ignore_match_mode == "exact":
+            return module in self.ignore
+        if self.ignore_match_mode == "substring":
+            return any(ignored in module for ignored in self.ignore)
+        return any(module == ignored or module.endswith(f".{ignored}") for ignored in self.ignore)
+
+    def _compress(self, name: str, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        prefix = name[: -len("weight")]
+        compressed = _compress_weight(weight, self.scheme)
+        yield name, compressed["weight"]
+        yield prefix + "weight_scale_inv", compressed["weight_scale"]
+
+    def __call__(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        if self.passthrough:
+            # Megatron-Bridge already exported DeepSeek-V4's private FP8/FP4
+            # layout. vLLM allocated the expert bytes as uint8, so only
+            # reinterpret the packed values and E8M0 scales before transfer.
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                if ".experts." in name and tensor.dtype in (torch.int8, torch.float8_e8m0fnu):
+                    tensor = tensor.view(torch.uint8)
+                yield name, tensor
+            return
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            packed = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name) if tensor.ndim == 3 else None
+            if packed:
+                probe = f"{packed['prefix']}.0.gate_proj"
+                if self._is_ignored(probe):
+                    yield name, tensor
+                else:
+                    for weight_name, weight in _unpack_experts(name, tensor):
+                        yield from self._compress(weight_name, weight)
+                continue
+
+            if (
+                not name.endswith(".weight")
+                or tensor.ndim != 2
+                or tensor.dtype not in _HIGH_PRECISION_DTYPES
+                or self._is_ignored(name[: -len(".weight")])
+            ):
+                yield name, tensor
+                continue
+            yield from self._compress(name, tensor)
+
+
+def _as_quantization_config(config: Any) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if config is None:
+        return None
+    if hasattr(config, "to_dict"):
+        config = config.to_dict()
+    if isinstance(config, Mapping):
+        return dict(config)
+    raise TypeError(f"quantization_config must be a mapping, got {type(config).__name__}")
+
+
+def dispatch_rollout_weight_quantizer(
+    *,
+    model_config: Any,
+    rollout_config: Any,
+    qat_config: Any = None,
+) -> Optional[CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer | Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer]:
+    """Select the trainer-side exporter for native or overridden rollout quantization.
+
+    The rollout engine keeps its native ``quantization_config`` unless
+    ``rollout.quantization`` explicitly overrides it. Both native and override
+    compressed-tensors configs use :class:`CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer`;
+    native ``Fp8Config`` uses :class:`Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer`. DeepSeek-V4
+    still gets an FP8 quantizer object, but it passes through the private mixed
+    FP8/FP4 layout already produced by Megatron-Bridge.
+    """
+    rollout_quantization = getattr(rollout_config, "quantization", None)
+    linear = getattr(rollout_quantization, "linear", None)
+    moe = getattr(rollout_quantization, "moe", None)
+    ignore = getattr(rollout_quantization, "ignore", None) or []
+    config_file = getattr(rollout_quantization, "config_file", None)
+    has_override = bool(linear or moe or config_file)
+
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    if has_override:
+        quantization_config = build_compressed_tensors_config(
+            linear=linear,
+            moe=moe,
+            ignore=ignore,
+            config_file=config_file,
+            model_path=model_config.local_path,
+        )
+    else:
+        native = getattr(hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+        if native is None:
+            native = getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "quantization_config", None)
+        quantization_config = _as_quantization_config(native)
+
+    qat_mode = qat_config.mode if qat_config is not None and qat_config.enable else None
+    if quantization_config is None:
+        if qat_mode is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "QAT needs a quantized rollout to sync to: use a model with a native "
+                "quantization_config or set rollout.quantization.linear / moe / config_file"
+            )
+        return None
+
+    quant_method = str(quantization_config.get("quant_method", "")).lower()
+    if quant_method == "compressed-tensors":
+        qat_modes = qat_modes_for_config(quantization_config) if qat_mode is not None else set()
+        quantizer = CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer(quantization_config)
+    elif "fp8" in quant_method:
+        qat_modes = {"fp8"}
+        model_types = {
+            getattr(hf_config, "model_type", None),
+            getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "model_type", None),
+        }
+        quantizer = Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer(quantization_config, model_types=model_types)
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Trainer-side rollout weight export does not support native quant_method={quant_method!r}"
+        )
+
+    if qat_mode is not None and qat_modes != {qat_mode}:
+        raise ValueError(f"QAT mode {qat_mode!r} does not match rollout quantization (QAT modes {qat_modes})")
+    return quantizer

**This test breaks CPU unit-test collection when vLLM is not installed.**

The module-level import of `verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp4_utils` loads the `verl.utils.vllm` package. That package imports `vllm`. +    """
+    match = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name)
+    prefix, proj = match["prefix"], match["proj"]
+    for expert_id, weight in enumerate(tensor):
+        if proj == "gate_up_proj":
+            gate, up = weight.chunk(2, dim=0)
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.gate_proj.weight", gate
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.up_proj.weight", up
+        else:
+            yield f"{prefix}.{expert_id}.down_proj.weight", weight
+
+
+class CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer:
+    """Quantize exported HF weights to match a compressed-tensors rollout config.
+
+    A weight is quantized iff it is a 2D ``*.weight`` whose module is not
+    ignored and is targeted by a config group, resolved like compressed-tensors
+    does: a name / "re:" target wins over the ``Linear`` class target. Packed 3D
+    experts are split per expert first. Everything else passes through unchanged.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        ct_config: Mapping[str, Any],
+        input_global_scales: Optional[Mapping[str, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+    ):
+        self.ignore = list(ct_config.get("ignore") or [])
+        self.schemes = _group_schemes(ct_config)
+        self.linear_scheme = next((s for s in self.schemes if "Linear" in s.targets), None)
+        self.input_global_scales = dict(input_global_scales or {})
+
+    def set_input_global_scales(self, scales: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+        """Install ModelOpt-observed NVFP4 activation scales keyed by HF module name."""
+        self.input_global_scales = dict(scales)
+
+    def refresh_input_global_scales(self, model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        """Refresh NVFP4 activation scales from ModelOpt before an export."""
+        from verl.utils.qat.modelopt import collect_nvfp4_input_global_scales
+
+        scales = collect_nvfp4_input_global_scales(model)
+        if scales:
+            self.set_input_global_scales(scales)
+
+    def _input_global_scale(self, module: str, scheme: "QuantizationScheme") -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+
+        if scheme.input_activations is None or scheme.input_activations.strategy != QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP:
+            return None
+        scale = self.input_global_scales.get(module)
+        if scale is None:
+            match = re.search(r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.mlp\.experts\.\d+\.(gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj)$", module)
+            if match:
+                projection = "gate_up" if match.group(2) in ("gate_proj", "up_proj") else "down"
+                scale = self.input_global_scales.get(f"layers.{match.group(1)}.mlp.experts.{projection}")
+        if scale is None:
+            # The first rollout sync precedes any actor forward, so no observer
+            # value exists yet.  One is the neutral CT divisor and leaves the
+            # dynamic group-16 FP8 local scales their full representable range.
+            scale = torch.ones(1)
+        scale = scale.detach().float().reshape(1)
+        if not torch.isfinite(scale).all() or (scale <= 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"Invalid input_global_scale for {module!r}: {scale}")
+        return scale
+
+    def _compress_packed_experts(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        scheme: "QuantizationScheme",
+    ) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        """Compress packed experts, sharing NVFP4 gate/up tensor scales."""
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+        from compressed_tensors.quantization.utils import generate_gparam
+
+        unpacked = list(_unpack_experts(name, tensor))
+        shared_global_scales: dict[tuple[int, str], torch.Tensor] = {}
+        if scheme.weights.strategy == QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR_GROUP:
+            by_expert: dict[int, list[torch.Tensor]] = {}
+            for module_name, weight in unpacked:
+                match = re.search(r"\.experts\.(\d+)\.(gate_proj|up_proj)\.weight$", module_name)
+                if match:
+                    by_expert.setdefault(int(match.group(1)), []).append(weight)
+            for expert_id, weights in by_expert.items():
+                amax = torch.stack([weight.float().abs().amax() for weight in weights]).amax()
+                shared_global_scales[(expert_id, "gate_up")] = generate_gparam(-amax, amax)
+
+        for weight_name, weight in unpacked:
+            module = weight_name[: -len(".weight")]
+            match = re.search(r"\.experts\.(\d+)\.(gate_proj|up_proj)$", module)
+            global_scale = shared_global_scales.get((int(match.group(1)), "gate_up")) if match else None
+            compressed = _compress_weight(weight, scheme, global_scale=global_scale)
+            for key, value in compressed.items():
+                yield weight_name[: -len("weight")] + key, value
+            input_scale = self._input_global_scale(module, scheme)
+            if input_scale is not None:
+                yield weight_name[: -len("weight")] + "input_global_scale", input_scale
+
+    def _module_scheme(self, module: str) -> Optional["QuantizationScheme"]:
+        if _matches(module, self.ignore):
+            return None
+        for scheme in self.schemes:
+            if _matches(module, scheme.targets):
+                return scheme
+        return self.linear_scheme
+
+    def _scheme_for(self, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Optional["QuantizationScheme"]:
+        if not name.endswith(".weight") or tensor.ndim != 2 or tensor.dtype not in _HIGH_PRECISION_DTYPES:
+            return None
+        return self._module_scheme(name[: -len(".weight")])
+
+    def __call__(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            packed = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name) if tensor.ndim == 3 else None
+            scheme = self._module_scheme(f"{packed['prefix']}.0.gate_proj") if packed else None
+            if packed and scheme is not None:
+                yield from self._compress_packed_experts(name, tensor, scheme)
+                continue
+            scheme = self._scheme_for(name, tensor)
+            if scheme is None:
+                yield name, tensor
+                continue
+            prefix = name[: -len("weight")]
+            for key, value in _compress_weight(tensor, scheme).items():
+                yield prefix + key, value
+            input_scale = self._input_global_scale(name[: -len(".weight")], scheme)
+            if input_scale is not None:
+                yield prefix + "input_global_scale", input_scale
+
+
+class Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer:
+    """Export trainer weights in vLLM's native blockwise ``Fp8Config`` layout.
+
+    Unlike :class:`CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer`, this keeps the rollout's
+    native ``Fp8Config`` and therefore emits ``weight_scale_inv`` rather than
+    compressed-tensors' ``weight_scale``.  The quantization calculation is
+    shared with the compressed-tensors FP8_BLOCK exporter.
+
+    DeepSeek-V4 uses this dispatcher entry too, but the quantizer passes through
+    its private mixed FP8/FP4 layout already exported by Megatron-Bridge.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, fp8_config: Mapping[str, Any], *, model_types: Iterable[Optional[str]] = ()):
+        quant_method = str(fp8_config.get("quant_method", "")).lower()
+        self.passthrough = bool({"deepseek_v4", "deepseek_v41"} & set(model_types))
+        if self.passthrough:
+            return
+        activation_scheme = fp8_config.get("activation_scheme")
+        block_size = fp8_config.get("weight_block_size")
+        store_dtype = fp8_config.get("store_dtype")
+        if "fp8" not in quant_method:
+            raise ValueError(f"Expected an FP8 quantization config, got quant_method={quant_method!r}")
+        if activation_scheme != "dynamic" or block_size != [128, 128] or store_dtype is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Trainer-side native Fp8Config export currently supports only standard "
+                "FP8_BLOCK (dynamic activations, 128x128 weights, no mixed expert store_dtype); "
+                f"got activation_scheme={activation_scheme!r}, weight_block_size={block_size!r}, "
+                f"store_dtype={store_dtype!r}"
+            )
+        self.ignore = list(fp8_config.get("ignored_layers") or fp8_config.get("modules_to_not_convert") or [])
+        self.ignore_match_mode = fp8_config.get("ignored_layers_match_mode", "exact")
+        if self.ignore_match_mode not in ("exact", "substring", "suffix"):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported ignored_layers_match_mode={self.ignore_match_mode!r}")
+        self.scheme = _scheme_for_preset("FP8_BLOCK", ["Linear"])
+
+    def _is_ignored(self, module: str) -> bool:
+        if _matches(module, DEFAULT_IGNORE):
+            return True
+        if self.ignore_match_mode == "exact":
+            return module in self.ignore
+        if self.ignore_match_mode == "substring":
+            return any(ignored in module for ignored in self.ignore)
+        return any(module == ignored or module.endswith(f".{ignored}") for ignored in self.ignore)
+
+    def _compress(self, name: str, weight: torch.Tensor) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        prefix = name[: -len("weight")]
+        compressed = _compress_weight(weight, self.scheme)
+        yield name, compressed["weight"]
+        yield prefix + "weight_scale_inv", compressed["weight_scale"]
+
+    def __call__(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        if self.passthrough:
+            # Megatron-Bridge already exported DeepSeek-V4's private FP8/FP4
+            # layout. vLLM allocated the expert bytes as uint8, so only
+            # reinterpret the packed values and E8M0 scales before transfer.
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                if ".experts." in name and tensor.dtype in (torch.int8, torch.float8_e8m0fnu):
+                    tensor = tensor.view(torch.uint8)
+                yield name, tensor
+            return
+        for name, tensor in weights:
+            packed = _PACKED_EXPERTS.match(name) if tensor.ndim == 3 else None
+            if packed:
+                probe = f"{packed['prefix']}.0.gate_proj"
+                if self._is_ignored(probe):
+                    yield name, tensor
+                else:
+                    for weight_name, weight in _unpack_experts(name, tensor):
+                        yield from self._compress(weight_name, weight)
+                continue
+
+            if (
+                not name.endswith(".weight")
+                or tensor.ndim != 2
+                or tensor.dtype not in _HIGH_PRECISION_DTYPES
+                or self._is_ignored(name[: -len(".weight")])
+            ):
+                yield name, tensor
+                continue
+            yield from self._compress(name, tensor)
+
+
+def _as_quantization_config(config: Any) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if config is None:
+        return None
+    if hasattr(config, "to_dict"):
+        config = config.to_dict()
+    if isinstance(config, Mapping):
+        return dict(config)
+    raise TypeError(f"quantization_config must be a mapping, got {type(config).__name__}")
+
+
+def dispatch_rollout_weight_quantizer(
+    *,
+    model_config: Any,
+    rollout_config: Any,
+    qat_config: Any = None,
+) -> Optional[CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer | Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer]:
+    """Select the trainer-side exporter for native or overridden rollout quantization.
+
+    The rollout engine keeps its native ``quantization_config`` unless
+    ``rollout.quantization`` explicitly overrides it. Both native and override
+    compressed-tensors configs use :class:`CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer`;
+    native ``Fp8Config`` uses :class:`Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer`. DeepSeek-V4
+    still gets an FP8 quantizer object, but it passes through the private mixed
+    FP8/FP4 layout already produced by Megatron-Bridge.
+    """
+    rollout_quantization = getattr(rollout_config, "quantization", None)
+    linear = getattr(rollout_quantization, "linear", None)
+    moe = getattr(rollout_quantization, "moe", None)
+    ignore = getattr(rollout_quantization, "ignore", None) or []
+    config_file = getattr(rollout_quantization, "config_file", None)
+    has_override = bool(linear or moe or config_file)
+
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    if has_override:
+        quantization_config = build_compressed_tensors_config(
+            linear=linear,
+            moe=moe,
+            ignore=ignore,
+            config_file=config_file,
+            model_path=model_config.local_path,
+        )
+    else:
+        native = getattr(hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+        if native is None:
+            native = getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "quantization_config", None)
+        quantization_config = _as_quantization_config(native)
+
+    qat_mode = qat_config.mode if qat_config is not None and qat_config.enable else None
+    if quantization_config is None:
+        if qat_mode is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "QAT needs a quantized rollout to sync to: use a model with a native "
+                "quantization_config or set rollout.quantization.linear / moe / config_file"
+            )
+        return None
+
+    quant_method = str(quantization_config.get("quant_method", "")).lower()
+    if quant_method == "compressed-tensors":
+        qat_modes = qat_modes_for_config(quantization_config) if qat_mode is not None else set()
+        quantizer = CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer(quantization_config)
+    elif "fp8" in quant_method:
+        qat_modes = {"fp8"}
+        model_types = {
+            getattr(hf_config, "model_type", None),
+            getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "model_type", None),
+        }
+        quantizer = Fp8ConfigWeightQuantizer(quantization_config, model_types=model_types)
+    else:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Trainer-side rollout weight export does not support native quant_method={quant_method!r}"
+        )

**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**The initial `1.0` NVFP4 input global scale never changes.**

`_nvfp4_global_scale` returns `generate_gparam(-amax, amax)`, which is about `448*6/amax`. For any activation with `amax < 2688`, this value is greater than `1.0`. The first call initializes `previous` to `1.0`, and `torch.minimum(previous, current)` keeps `1.0`. Every later call returns `1.0` again. The running scale therefore never takes an observed value.

With a global scale of `1.0`, each local FP8 scale is about `group_amax/6`. For small activations this value falls into the E4M3 subnormal range or underflows, so activation QDQ error is large. The export path receives the same `1.0`, so trainer and rollout stay consistent. Accuracy is still lost. This may explain part of the large NVFP4 mismatch that `nvfp4_qat.md` reports.

Keep `1.0` only as the export fallback before any observation. That fallback already exists in `CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer._input_global_scale`. Seed the running value from the first observation.

<summary>🐛 Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
--- "a/verl/utils/qat/modelopt.py"
+++ "b/verl/utils/qat/modelopt.py"
@@ -162,14 +162,12 @@

     # group-16 scales remain dynamic. Keep a running maximum during QAT and use
     # that exact scale for both fake quant and checkpoint export.
     current = _nvfp4_global_scale(inputs)
     previous = getattr(quantizer, "_verl_input_global_scale", None)
-    if previous is None:
-        # A neutral divisor keeps the full FP8 local-scale range available and
-        # also gives the first pre-rollout weight sync a deterministic value.
-        previous = torch.ones_like(current)
-    current = torch.minimum(previous.to(current.device), current)
+    if previous is not None:
+        # Running max of amax == running min of the global divisor.
+        current = torch.minimum(previous.to(current.device), current)
     quantizer._verl_input_global_scale = current.detach()
     return _Nvfp4FakeQuant.apply(inputs, current)
 
 
```
